faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions.
faq.heroTitle: The questions salons ask us most
faq.heroSubtext: Can’t find yours? Message us and we reply within 24 hours, in Vietnamese or Czech.
faq.q1: Do I need anything complicated to get started?
faq.a1: Nope. Just sign up and you can use it straight away in your browser. If you want the Desktop app, installation is quick too.
faq.q2: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.a2: Yes. Open the app in your phone's browser to check bookings, take payments and see revenue at any time.
faq.q3: I'm not tech-savvy. Can I still use it?
faq.a3: Yes. SalonGo is made for salon owners, not IT people. If you need help getting started, our team will support you.
faq.a4: Yes. Data is stored and backed up regularly. Customer and revenue information is always protected.
faq.q5: Am I locked into a contract?
faq.a5: No. Pay monthly or yearly and change plan or stop renewing right in the app. No hidden fees.
faq.a6: Yes. Each staff member is paid a percentage of their own revenue or a fixed monthly salary. The owner picks how tips are shared: to whoever the client tipped, or split equally. Payroll is totalled every period.
faq.q7: Is SalonGo for small or large salons?
faq.a7: Both. You can start small and upgrade as your salon grows.
faq.q8: Can I try before I decide?
faq.a8: Yes. Every new salon gets a free 150-day trial with every feature, no card needed.
faq.a9: We reply within 24 hours, in Vietnamese and Czech. You won't be left on your own.
faq.closingParagraph: Still unsure? The best way is to try it and see for yourself before deciding.
faq.noResults: No questions match. Try different keywords or contact support.
faq.q10: Where do I renew my plan?
faq.a10: Click "Renew plan" on the website (menu, price list) or open the plan screen in the app. The website takes you straight to the plan screen of the location you have open; only the owner can renew.
faq.q11: How can I pay for a plan?
faq.a11: By card, or by bank transfer when the app offers it to the salon. The renew button never charges by itself: you always see the price and confirm in the app.
faq.q12: What happens when my plan expires?
faq.a12: Your data stays. The app reminds you 2 days before. After expiry some features are locked until you renew, while checkout and invoices keep working.
faq.q13: I have several locations. Is that OK?
faq.a13: Yes. One owner account runs every location and switches from the menu. Each location has its own plan and end date.
faq.q14: Which languages does the app have?
faq.a14: Vietnamese, Czech, Slovak, English, German and French, for both the salon app and the client booking page.
faq.q15: How do I send a marketing email to clients?
faq.a15: Go to Clients → Marketing, pick one of 10 occasion templates, edit the text, add an offer if you like, preview and send. It only reaches clients with an email who agreed to offers; one campaign per salon per day. Included in every plan.
